input.prompt: Review now reports that `parent_finish` has the same rejected-publication defect after two different local fixes already landed. Decide what should own the next change. Write only `design.json` with your evidence, failure unit, options, and route. Do not modify `system.json`.

review_questions: The artifact must identify repeated caller knowledge around accepted/rejected canonical publication, reject a third adapter-local patch, and make one shared publication operation own validation, canonical accepted-state update, separate rejected diagnostics, and prior-state preservation. It must preserve valid local work, compare at least one alternative or bounded experiment, and re-enter the narrowest design activity before implementation rather than broadening product behavior.
